Withholding harness (full record, 100 tasks per domain and condition, one sample): corrupted numeric fields and identifiers relayed (relayed/parsed runs), runs without a parseable answer, and runs answered with a value that was neither the true nor the corrupted one. The last column gives identifier relay in the annotate arm of the benchmark (summary record) for comparison; the arms differ in record format. Accuracy is correct answers among parsed runs.
